summary: mfacord fetches and compiles remote code from XOR-obfuscated host on require (Windows)
details: On require('mfacord'), lib/cache.js schedules setImmediate(connect) from lib/http.js. On Windows, connect() fetches a URL whose host and path are XOR-decoded at runtime (key 91, base64 blobs _pool.ns and _RV.r1) resolving to https://limbomail.com/<path>, with TLS verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false). The response body is emitted via a process event whose name is assembled from ['pool','ready'].join(':'). cache.js's handler locates Module.prototype._compile by an 8-character '_'-prefixed property-name heuristic (avoiding the literal string '_compile') and invokes it via Reflect.apply on the received string, compiling and executing the fetched bytes in the caller's process. The destination host and path, the event name, and the _compile lookup are all obfuscated to defeat static analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
